answer.reason: The marked verses tell of James's call, his presence at the transfiguration, and his death by Herod's sword.

clauses.english: left his ship and his father at Jesus' call and followed him
clauses.quote: they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him

clauses.english: was taken up the high mountain with Peter and John, where Jesus was transfigured
clauses.quote: Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother

clauses.english: was killed with the sword by Herod the king
clauses.quote: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

doubts: 1CO 15:7 (seen of James) probably concerns another James, so it was left out.
Other scenes (Jairus' daughter, the request for seats, the fire from heaven) were left out to keep the line short.
